_comment: I/O ledger of the target system: one entry per external signal of the ECU board (each of ECU1 and ECU2) and the Cockpit Controller, plus the on-chip modules the firmware touches. Hand-maintained; docs/io-ledger.md is GENERATED from it by scripts/gen_io_ledger_doc.py (make check-generated), and make io-coverage checks it against what the firmware actually touches. Evidence: DATASHEET (Microchip data sheet / DFP), DOCUMENTED (installation manual and drawings, operating procedures), OBSERVED (seen on the emulated system), MEASURED (on hardware), INFERRED (reasoned, not observed). modelled: yes / partial / no.

fault_vocabulary.short_supply: short to the supply / full scale
fault_vocabulary.out_of_range: a value outside the sensor's range
fault_vocabulary.garbage: protocol garbage / corrupted bytes on a bus
fault_vocabulary.brownout: supply sagging below the regulator's drop-out

signals.name: Manifold absolute pressure (MAP), one sensor per ECU
signals.connector: engine harness MAP connector (13 / 14), 3-wire sensor on the firewall
signals.peripheral: ADC1 scan (AN5..AN14, SMPI 9, external VREF RA10/RA9)
signals.electrical: ratiometric pressure sensor, 5 V excitation from its ECU; transfer inHg = 3.06 + 0.02674 x raw
signals.model: pin counts from the host / replay / live feed through the observed curve; per-sample noise; fault overlay
sources: install manual rev 6/19: two MAP sensors, one for each ECU
transfer curves observed: pin counts against the values the stock firmware displays
signals.notes: Open-circuit level of the signal pin not known (no schematic): modelled as 0 counts (INFERRED).

signals.name: Intake air temperature (IAT), one sensor per ECU
signals.connector: engine harness IAT connector (5 / 6), 2-wire thermistor on the throttle body
signals.electrical: NTC thermistor with board pull-up; deg F = 245 - raw x 100/376 (clamped)
signals.model: pin counts through the observed curve; open reads full scale (pull-up)
sources: install manual rev 6/19 p.21: two IAT sensors, both on the throttle body; each ECU reads its own
transfer curves observed: pin counts against the values the stock firmware displays
signals.notes: Open = 1023 counts (pull-up) is INFERRED from what the firmware displays with the sensor open, not a schematic.

signals.name: Engine temperature (ET): wired to ECU1 only
signals.connector: engine harness ET connector (3), 2-wire sensor in the right rear cylinder's upper injector port
signals.electrical: NTC thermistor with board pull-up; deg F = 265 - raw x 100/376
signals.model: ECU1 reads the sensor; ECU2's input is unconnected (open, full scale) unless S32_ET_WIRING=both
sources: install manual rev 6/19 p.22: the ET sensor is wired to ECU1 only; pre-start checks: ET reads '---' for ECU2
transfer curves observed: pin counts against the values the stock firmware displays

sources: channel identified on the bench (distinct counts per pin read back on the ECU console)
signals.notes: The documented wideband input is the Controller's DB-15 pin 3; this ECU channel's wiring is unknown.

sources: install manual rev 6/19 p.22: the one TPS sensor is read by both ECUs

signals.notes: The unpowered end state is INFERRED (no bench measurement): S32_TPS_UNPOWERED=gnd is the default, float and pullup bracket it.

signals.name: Injector drivers 1-8 (6 used on a six-cylinder engine)
signals.connector: fuel circular connector; injector wires bundled and labelled per cylinder (red/black per injector)
signals.peripheral: PORTA latch (open-drain ODCA = 0xFF): injector pins open at the crank edge and close on a 20 us grid
signals.electrical: open-drain gate drive to the board's injector driver stage; injectors wired in parallel to both ECUs; each ECU's drive gated by its injector-enable wire; injectors powered from the aircraft bus (the higher of the two live ECU feeds)
signals.model: driver-pin pulses per ECU (pin level) and the union at each injector after the enable gates (fuel at the engine); each opening delivers (open time - dead time) x static flow, the dead time following the injector's supply voltage (0.80 ms at 13.8 V, longer as the bus falls; no opening below 6 V)
sources: install manual rev 6/19 fuel injector connectors and semi-sequential firing
install manual rev 6/19, Drawing 9 (switch and breaker wiring)
stock firmware I/O configuration as the bench observes it (S32_IOCOV final TRIS/ANS/PPS/peripheral registers)
signals.notes: Which driver pin reaches which cylinder is not documented (the wire numbering is); modelled as RAn -> injector n+1. Driver-stage faults (open coil, shorted driver) are not modelled. The dead-time curve is the usual shape of a high-impedance injector's offset-vs-battery data normalised to 0.80 ms at 13.8 V (INFERRED: no data sheet for the installed injector).

on_chip.name: Reset control
on_chip.model: POR / MCLR through the harness; the core's own resets take the same path: RESET instruction (RCON.SWR), illegal opcode or illegal address mode (RCON.IOPUWR), hard-trap conflict (RCON.TRAPR). RCON keeps its flags across non-POR resets. BREAK with no debugger attached is treated as an illegal opcode (INFERRED-high: BREAK is not in the user instruction set). The uninitialized-W cause of IOPUWR is not detected. PIC24_ILLEGAL_STOPS=1 makes an illegal opcode stop the emulator instead (debug only)
